newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Servgro revamp news unlikely before Sept.
newsitem.headline: Servgro revamp news unlikely before Sept.

text.p: South African food to leisure firm Servgro International Ltd said on Friday that details of the second phase of its unbundling, announced in April, were unlikely to be made public before August 31.
The second phase of the unbundling will result in the distribution of the firm's cash resources and any realisation proceeds of its remaining assets.
It may also distribute Servgro's shares in its remaining assets, including Interleisure Ltd, Teljoy Holdings Ltd, The Fedics Group (Pty) Ltd and Interpark (Pty) Ltd.
On completion Servgro may be liquidated and delisted, it said.
Should any transaction be concluded before August 31, the firm would made an appropriate announcement. Shareholders were accordingly advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings.
